sloka: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च ।ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ।। ५.६७.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: imaṁ ca tīvraṁ mama śokavegaṁ rakṣobhirebhiḥ paribhartsanaṁ ca ।brūyāstu rāmasya gataḥ samīpaṁ śivaśca te 'dhvā 'stu haripravīra ।। 5.67.37 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then that lady said to me: 'Great monkey, bull among vanaras, that I should of my own will resort to your back — this is no dharma.
